name: metacognition
description: A metacognizer above the prompt: a fresh agent that watches the session for a simpler, higher-level move it is missing

model.title: Metacognizer model
model.description: The model the metacognizer runs on. session uses whatever model the session it watches runs.

effort.title: Metacognizer effort
effort.description: How hard the metacognizer thinks. session uses the session's own effort.
